claim: A canonical Verification was marked PASS before its gate had executed.
evidence: The prior evidence said the check would be rerun in future tense.
Verification PASS now carries command, exit code, and execution time.
impact: Audited records could claim an executed check that never occurred.
required_action: Require execution metadata for final PASS evidence and record canonical closure only after execution.

prevention.action: Approval and ACCEPT reject final PASS evidence without execution metadata; canonical closure remains NOT_RUN until executed.
